messages.content: 誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
截至我最後更新（2024‑06），英超歷史上助攻數量最多的是 **Ryan Giggs**，他在職業生涯中為曼徹斯特聯隊共送出 162 次助攻。  

> *備註：目前沒有可用的工具直接查詢「助攻」排行榜；上述數字來自公開統計資料。*

There's no function for assists. So we cannot use the tool. We can answer based on knowledge. As of my knowledge cutoff (2024-06), the record for most assists in Premier League history is Ryan Giggs? Actually, the all-time assists leader is Ryan Giggs with 162 assists. But the question might refer to current season? It says "英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員" - could be asking for the all-time record or current season? Usually such question refers to all-time record. So answer: Ryan Giggs holds the record with 162 assists.
